say.en: Some neurons in your body are almost a metre long, running from your spinal cord to your toes. What does such a cell look like? In this lesson: Label the cell body, dendrites, axon and synaptic knob.
Classify neurons as multipolar, bipolar and unipolar.
Compare myelinated and non-myelinated fibres.

body.en: A *neuron* is a microscopic structure with three major parts: the cell body, dendrites and the axon. The cell body contains cytoplasm with typical cell organelles and certain granular bodies called Nissl's granules. Short fibres that branch repeatedly and project out of the cell body, also containing Nissl's granules, are dendrites; they transmit impulses towards the cell body. The axon is a long fibre whose distal end is branched; each branch ends as a bulb-like structure called the synaptic knob, which has synaptic vesicles containing chemicals called neurotransmitters. Axons transmit nerve impulses away from the cell body to a synapse or to a neuromuscular junction.
body.kn: ನರಕೋಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಶಕಾಯ, ಡೆಂಡ್ರೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಆಕ್ಸಾನ್ ಎಂಬ ಮೂರು ಭಾಗಗಳಿವೆ. ಕೋಶಕಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಡೆಂಡ್ರೈಟ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಸ್ಸಲ್ ಕಣಗಳಿವೆ. ಡೆಂಡ್ರೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ಆವೇಗವನ್ನು ಕೋಶಕಾಯದ ಕಡೆ, ಆಕ್ಸಾನ್ ಕೋಶಕಾಯದಿಂದ ದೂರ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಕ್ಸಾನ್ ತುದಿಯ ಸಿನ್ಯಾಪ್ಟಿಕ್ ಗುಬುಟುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನರಪ್ರೇಷಕಗಳಿವೆ.

say.en: Start with the cell body, which holds the nucleus and Nissl’s granules. Short branched dendrites carry impulses towards it.
The long axon carries impulses away from the cell body. Schwann cells wrap it in a myelin sheath with gaps, the nodes of Ranvier.
At its end the axon branches into synaptic knobs full of vesicles with neurotransmitters.
So the impulse always travels one way: dendrite, cell body, axon, synaptic knob.
Neurons are named by how many processes leave the cell body: multipolar, bipolar and unipolar.

title.en: Types of neurons and nerve fibres

body.en: Based on the number of axons and dendrites, neurons are of three types. Multipolar neurons have one axon and two or more dendrites and are found in the cerebral cortex. Bipolar neurons have one axon and one dendrite and are found in the retina of the eye. Unipolar neurons have a cell body with one axon only and are usually found in the embryonic stage. Axons are of two types. Myelinated *nerve fibres* are enveloped by Schwann cells, which form a myelin sheath around the axon; the gaps between two adjacent myelin sheaths are the nodes of Ranvier. Myelinated fibres are found in spinal and cranial nerves. Unmyelinated nerve fibres are enclosed by a Schwann cell that does not form a myelin sheath, and are commonly found in the autonomous and the somatic neural systems.
body.kn: ಬಹುಧ್ರುವೀಯ ನರಕೋಶಗಳು ಮಿದುಳಿನ ಕಾರ್ಟೆಕ್ಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ, ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವೀಯ ನರಕೋಶಗಳು ಅಕ್ಷಿಪಟಲದಲ್ಲಿ, ಏಕಧ್ರುವೀಯ ನರಕೋಶಗಳು ಭ್ರೂಣ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡುಬರುತ್ತವೆ. ಶ್ವಾನ್ ಕೋಶಗಳು ಮೈಲಿನ್ ಪೊರೆ ರಚಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಅವುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಅಂತರಗಳು ರಾನ್ವಿಯರ್ ಗಂಟುಗಳು.

problem.en: A neuron is seen to have one axon and a single dendrite. Another has one axon and seven dendrites. Name each type and where it is found. If the second neuron's axon has gaps in its sheath every millimetre, what are these gaps?

steps.en: One axon + one dendrite = bipolar neuron, found in the retina of the eye.
One axon + two or more dendrites = multipolar neuron, found in the cerebral cortex.
Gaps between adjacent myelin sheaths formed by Schwann cells are the nodes of Ranvier, so the axon is myelinated.

answer.en: Bipolar (retina); multipolar (cerebral cortex); the gaps are nodes of Ranvier

narration.en: Recap. A neuron has a cell body, dendrites and an axon ending in synaptic knobs. Dendrites carry impulses to the cell body; the axon carries them away. Multipolar: cerebral cortex; bipolar: retina; unipolar: embryo. Schwann cells form the myelin sheath; gaps are nodes of Ranvier.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ನರಕೋಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಶಕಾಯ, ಡೆಂಡ್ರೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಿನ್ಯಾಪ್ಟಿಕ್ ಗುಬುಟುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ಆಕ್ಸಾನ್ ಇವೆ. ಡೆಂಡ್ರೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ಆವೇಗವನ್ನು ಕೋಶಕಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ತರುತ್ತವೆ; ಆಕ್ಸಾನ್ ದೂರ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಹುಧ್ರುವೀಯ: ಕಾರ್ಟೆಕ್ಸ್; ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವೀಯ: ಅಕ್ಷಿಪಟಲ; ಏಕಧ್ರುವೀಯ: ಭ್ರೂಣ. ಶ್ವಾನ್ ಕೋಶಗಳು ಮೈಲಿನ್ ಪೊರೆ ರಚಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಅಂತರಗಳು ರಾನ್ವಿಯರ್ ಗಂಟುಗಳು.
